board:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: production design specification board for Xiaomeng Android live notifications / floating island, portrait high-resolution.
Input images: Image 1 (mascot-avatar.png) and Image 2 (hero-orbit.png) are identity and material references only, preserve exactly this latest porcelain bunny character: two rounded long ears, shiny black oval eyes, tiny curved smile, soft matte white ceramic, small lime star. Do not use the old ghost/cat mascot.
Primary request: design an elegant, realistically implementable Chinese live notification UI matching the existing Nightflight Studio application: porcelain #F5F6F2, deep ink #11151B, lime #D9F66F, sage #E9EDDF, readable Chinese sans. A cohesive designed UI board, NOT a phone hardware marketing render. Use intentional generous margins and very clean hierarchy.
Top title exact Chinese: "小梦 · 实时在场". Small subtitle "实时通知主题设计".
Upper section: four compact dark system-style status capsules in a tidy 2x2 arrangement. Monochrome white bunny silhouette on left, concise status on right: "运行中", "待确认", "已完成", "已离线". Small lime or amber indicator for the relevant state. No text or progress that suggests fabricated timestamps.
Middle section title "系统实时通知". Show one light Android standard expanded notification card and one dark-mode counterpart stacked. Include unobtrusive system header "小梦 · 实时状态", project title "品牌官网", status "正在处理任务", short task summary "调整首页布局与交互细节", porcelain bunny LARGE ICON at right, thin lime progress bar with a tiny bunny tracker, progress text "3 / 5". Standard template appearance, neutral system surfaces, no decorative full-bleed custom background, no huge hero artwork.
Lower section title "主题展开卡片". Show two native-custom-content style cards stacked: a running dark card with bunny avatar 48px left, right content "品牌官网" and "小梦正在专注处理", lime short status label "运行中", restrained thin progress 3 / 5 and small text button "查看任务"; an approval dark card with a slightly tilted bunny holding a small warm amber circle, title "有件事，等你确认", project subtitle "品牌官网 · 执行命令", amber status "待确认", short command "npm run build", and two clearly distinct functional buttons "拒绝" outlined and "批准" filled pale lime. Keep native custom content within a realistic 220dp high notification. Corners 16dp, no nested pill overload.
Footer small plain Chinese note "顶部胶囊与系统通知布局随设备变化". The layout is an implementation guide, not a promise of identical Android OEM chrome. Focus on polished proportional typography, aligned icon sizes, consistent mascot, modest detail and legibility. No extra slogans, branding, watermark, random English, pink or purple. All text and buttons should be clean flat UI, mascot is the only 3D rendered content.

assets.running:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production app notification avatar artwork, square, 1024x1024. Reference images define Xiaomeng's exact current identity: matte porcelain-white bunny with two rounded long ears, black oval eyes, tiny curved mouth, rounded arms. Match the white bunny exactly. Deliberately OPAQUE flat solid deep-ink background #11151B across the entire canvas, no transparency, no checkerboard, no grid, no swirls, no room, no vignette, no gradient. This is an intentional dark portrait badge. Centered complete bust with both ears and chest prop fully visible, all subject confined to central 76% of canvas to allow circular clipping later. Soft studio light, clean coherent small-size silhouette, premium ceramic texture. No text, no letters, no watermark, no orbit, no UI, no border, no additional small icons.
Running state: open attentive oval eyes, calm smile, holds a large pale-lime #D9F66F five-point star tightly at chest.
